# how-to-web Dialog

> Reconstruction guidance for the how-to-web modal Dialog organism.

Use [Build DNA](./build-dna.json) as the normative contract. The examples demonstrate different focus strategies; they are not separate specifications.

## Platform notes

- Prefer native `<dialog>` + `showModal()`.
- For cancellation/dismissal, `requestClose()` is the preferred modern close-request API when supported; fall back as needed.
- `closedby` may express light dismiss but is not a required baseline capability.
- Invoker Commands may be used declaratively on current browser targets, but are an implementation option rather than part of the normative contract.
- Use `aria-describedby` selectively; avoid flattening long structured content into one large description.

## Agent instruction

Preserve modal semantics, accessible naming, initial-focus strategy, background inertness, Escape, explicit dismissal and focus return. Prefer native dialog behavior when available. Do not invent backdrop-close, destructive defaults or workflow side effects.
